subject: Re: Rerank model fit validation & A/B plan

Subject: Follow-up: Rerank discovery + next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: improve search relevance on product pages (browse & facet-driven queries).
- Current infra: ElasticSearch + heuristic reranker; want to try ML-based reranking for top-10 results.
- Success metrics: NDCG@10 primary, MRR secondary; safe regressions important for checkout paths.
- Constraints: 150ms target for tail latency on rerank per request, budget-conscious (pilot < $Xk/month).

Recommended next steps:
1) Share preliminary evals (we'll run rerank model fit on a holdout prompt set you provide).
2) Agree on A/B test gating thresholds (target +0.10 NDCG@10 or safe fallback).
3) Identify pilot routes (catalog search / category browse).

I'll run a quick fit with our candidate models and share NDCG/MRR numbers and prompt sets by end of week. Can you confirm the dataset export (s3 link) or point me to the search logs slice you prefer?

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Rerank model fit results (NDCG/MRR) + prompt sets

Alex —

Attached are the initial model-fit artifacts from our offline eval on your 30-day slice. High-level summary below; full numbers in attached ndcg_mrr_results.csv and the evaluated prompt_set_v3.txt.

Quick summary (holdout test set):
- Baseline (heuristic): NDCG@10 = 0.420, MRR = 0.370
- Candidate A (distil-rerank-3B, quantized): NDCG@10 = 0.560 (+0.140), MRR = 0.520 (+0.150)
- Candidate B (cross-encoder-1.2B): NDCG@10 = 0.535 (+0.115), MRR = 0.495 (+0.125)

Per-intent notes:
- Informational queries: Candidate A large gains (NDCG +0.18).
- Transactional (purchase intent): smaller gains (+0.06), but no observed regressions in the top-1 positions.
- Single-product/sku queries: flagged for manual review; small number of reranks that move the exact-match product down — we marked these in the CSV.

Latency/Perf (estimated in our runtime profile):
- Candidate A p95 rerank latency (top-10) = ~80ms on our Dedicated profile (batching enabled).
- Candidate B p95 = ~120ms. Both within potential pilot SLOs with configuration tuning; Candidate A looks best for latency/cost tradeoff.

Recommendation:
- Pilot Candidate A with a conservative A/B rollout (10% traffic) and guardrails: fallback to baseline for queries matching exact-match SKU signals.
- Log full request/response for 1% sample to monitor regressions and calibration.

Attachments included: ndcg_mrr_results.csv (detailed per-query rows), prompt_set_v3.txt (labeling/prompts used), model_recommendation.pdf (short writeup).

Let me know if you'd like a short walkthrough — happy to set up a 30-min session to go through the CSV and flagged examples.

Thanks,
Marissa\nAttachments: ndcg_mrr_results.csv (CSV, 256KB); prompt_set_v3.txt (TXT, 34KB); model_recommendation.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rerank model fit results (NDCG/MRR) + prompt sets

Thanks for the quick analysis — solid uplift on Candidate A. A couple of operational/QA points before we finalize the A/B plan to send to Acme: 

1) Regression guardrails: we need a deterministic SKU exact-match detector in the routing layer (if exact-match present, always prefer baseline) and a fallback when model score delta > threshold negative. We should document the rule-set and add to the rollout runbook.

2) Sample size & detectability: for +0.14 NDCG@10 on the test set, recommend 2 weeks at 10% traffic for statistical significance across intents (we can compute exact sample size with CTR baselines).

3) Monitoring: log top-5 tokens/scores, rank delta, and user engagement metrics. Also add alerting for any negative delta in conversion-critical funnels.

4) A/B plan: start 10% for 2 weeks, automatic rollback if NDCG@10 drops >0.03 vs baseline or if checkout funnel regression observed.

Marcus — can you prepare a short runbook with the SKU detector implementation notes and the logging schema? I'll draft the A/B toggle config and guardrail thresholds. Marissa — I'll review the CSV tonight and flag any high-risk queries.

-Rishi
Principal ML Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Rerank model fit results (NDCG/MRR) + A/B plan

Alex —

Thanks for the confirmation and the export. Per Rishi's notes, here's a concise proposed pilot plan we can share with your infra/ops team: 

Pilot proposal (summary):
- Model: Candidate A (distil-rerank-3B, quantized)
- Traffic: 10% (bucketed by user ID), Duration: 2 weeks
- Guardrails: SKU exact-match detector -> route to baseline; auto-rollback if NDCG@10 drops >0.03 or checkout funnel impact detected
- Logging: top-5 ranks + scores, rank_delta, request_id, and anonymized user_event ids (1% full payload).
- Monitoring: daily NDCG/MRR reports (per-intent), weekly review with Acme.

Next steps:
1) Marcus to deliver runbook and SKU detector notes (internal).
2) Acme to provision test toggle and provide traffic slice details (Alex).
3) Redwood to deploy Candidate A to a Pilot Dedicated profile and enable logging.

Alex — can you confirm access for Marcus to your feature toggle system and approximate pilot start date? If helpful, we can schedule the 30-min walkthrough this week to go through flagged examples (I have Wednesday/Thursday open).

Best,
Marissa
